video.title: Introduction video
video.subtitle: Introduce yourself in 1 minute: the Trato Directo team will get to know you better before putting you forward to a company.
video.tip1: Say who you are, your experience and what job you are looking for.
video.tip2: Explain why you would be a good fit: your strengths and availability.
video.tip3: Find good light and a quiet place, with no background noise.
video.limits: Maximum 1 minute. MP4, MOV or WebM formats. We optimise it before saving so it takes up little space.
video.reviewText: Review your video before saving it.
video.currentText: This is your current introduction video.
video.privacy: Only the Trato Directo team will see it; it is not shared with companies. You can delete it at any time.
video.cameraDenied: We do not have permission to use the camera. Allow it in your browser or upload a video recorded on your phone.
video.cameraUnavailable: The camera could not be accessed. You can upload a video recorded on your phone.
video.errorType: That file is not a video. Upload an MP4, MOV or WebM.
video.errorSize: The video is too large. Try "Record now" or a shorter video.
video.errorCompress: This browser cannot optimise that video. Try "Record now" or upload it from another browser (Chrome or Safari).
video.compressingHint: It takes about as long as the video. Do not close this page.
video.disabled: The introduction video is not available at the moment.
video.errorDuration: The video lasts {0} seconds. The maximum is 1 minute.
video.errorSession: Your session has expired. Sign in again and repeat the upload.
video.errorUpload: The video could not be saved. Please try again.
